info.name: When I Work API Documentation Accounts Punch API

items.docs: Punch the current user or another user in. The punch creator's ID will also be recorded.
Punch the current user or another user out. The punch creator's ID will also be recorded.

params.name: userId
params.description: User ID if looking up the punch state for another user, may allow additional actions

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location ID (schedule) used to verify if the user can punch in at this location

params.name: siteId
params.description: Job site used to verify if the user can punch in at this site

params.name: shiftId
params.description: Shift ID used to verify if the user can punch into this shift

params.name: deviceType
params.description: Type of device used to perform the punch

params.name: latitude
params.description: Current latitude used to verify punch restrictions for strict location validation

params.name: longitude
params.description: Current longitude used to verify punch restrictions for strict location validation

params.name: confidence
params.description: Expand the location search area by a given confidence to the provided location

items.docs: Gets a users punch state and allowed actions
